_doc: Generic provisioning map (Option B). Email -> fixture filename. studio-config-get reads THIS instead of a hardcoded map in code, so adding a client is a data edit (drop their fixture in data/, add one line here), not a code change. Caroline was the first; Vikram is the first paying client. Email keys are lowercased.
_test_note: starbucks005+caroline@gmail.com is a TEST alias for Dr. O to preview Caroline's studio from her own inbox (Gmail delivers +tags to starbucks005@gmail.com). It is treated as a buyer (not the owner), so edits write to a separate user_id and never touch Caroline's real account. Remove this line when testing is done.
